text:
marta: heads up for month-end close  vendor bill from KyotoCompute KK came in late and it's in JPY. invoice dated 2025-04-05 covers Mar reserved capacity (2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31). amount JPY 7,980,000. do we accrue and what FX do we use for the JE?
ajay: paste invoice snippet + contract ref plz. also confirm whether vendor is passthrough (billed to customer) or platform COGS.
marta: snippet and contract below. contract KC-RES-2021 term: vendor may submit within 45 days. vendor is platform COGS.
```
Invoice: KC-2025-0412
Service period: 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31
Invoice Date: 2025-04-05
Amount: JPY 7,980,000 (consumption execluded)
Vendor FX on invoice (for reference): 0.0071 USD/JPY
```
paul: revrec rules => revenue recognized where service delivered. revenue stays in Mar if entitlement exists. costs should be matched to revenue so accrue. issue: FX moved between invoice FX, month-end spot, and payment date. our policy is to use month-end spot FX for accrual (2025-03-31 spot = 0.0073 USD/JPY).
emily: agree with paul. accrual JE: debit Hosting COGS (6004) credit Accrued Liabilities (2112). use 0.0073 to convert JPY to USD for March accrual. calc: 7,980,000 * 0.0073 = 58,254.00 USD. include both invoice FX and policy spot FX in workpaper.
ajay: who signs? marta has approval up to 75k, this is below that but include a quick approval note. i'll prepare JE and binder upload.
marta: confirmed. i'll approve in binder. also need to attach FX screen grab from 2025-03-31 and contract clause for audit.
rev-bot: Month-end binder updated: new file uploaded by ajay (KC_accrual_calc_Mar2025.xlsx). :white_check_mark:
ajay: JE draft posted: JE_2025-03_ACCR_KC-0412.xlsx. Description: "Accrual for KyotoCompute late invoice; matched to March delivery; spot FX 2025-03-31 = 0.0073"
emily: small note for auditors: because vendor invoice FX (0.0071) differs from month-end spot (0.0073) the variance on invoice payment in April will go to FX gain/loss when we clear accrual. add reversal template in binder.
paul: add a one-line memo to the close pack explaining: why we used month-end spot, contract billing window, approval chain, and FX handling on reversal. auditors asked for that last quarter so let's be explicit.
ajay: done. posted reversal template and memo. tagging @marta for approval.
marta: approved. JE posted to GL (JE# 2025-03-1228). closing actions: ajay to reverse in April when invoice posts, emily to retain FX screenshots.
emily: noted. will keep binder evidence.
marta: resolved for March close. :heavy_check_mark:
